The plastic abloy Ava padlock. Flat and half round keyway version. Picked both. Both pick about the same. Half round is minimal more difficult to tension and picks slightly different due to round shape in the wafer. But that changes just pick placement. Orange or low green… it hurts, but I go with orange.

You have to hit the pins at an angle with a combination of pushing and rotating, which torques the core and requires delicate tension control to compensate.
